related_questions.question: How do I check my Nebraska Medicaid status?

text_blocks.snippet: To check your Nebraska Medicaid status, you can utilize the ACCESSNebraska website or the iServe Nebraska Portal. These platforms allow you to manage your account, including checking your eligibility dates and managing your benefits. You can also verify your eligibility by contacting Nebraska Medicaid directly.

list.snippet: Visit the ACCESSNebraska website or the iServe Nebraska Portal.
Create a new account or log in with your existing ACCESSNebraska account.
You can manage your password and security questions, apply for Medicaid and other benefits, upload documents, and report changes.
You can also check your eligibility date and manage your benefits through the portal.
For questions about your coverage, you can contact Nebraska Medicaid directly.
You can find specific contact numbers for Lincoln and Omaha on the Nebraska DHHS website.
Nebraska Total Care: If you have Nebraska Total Care, their secure portal may also offer options for verifying member eligibility.
Nebraska Medicaid Provider Portal: Providers can also verify eligibility through the Nebraska Medicaid Provider Portal.
Healthcare.gov: If you are no longer eligible for Medicaid, you can explore coverage options on Healthcare.gov.
